forum.title: crdb.zip Timeout during download
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@mnsandeepkumar

This issue has been fixed in the latest version of STM32CubeMX 6.18.1

Download STM32CubeMX6.18.1 from [this link.](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubemx.html)

Regards,

Souhaib
forum.content_text:
I am unable to start a project from STM32CubeMX running on Linux Mint. I have no proxy setup on my network and verified the same with Connection Parameters > Check Connection. I also tried the steps with another ISP, however the issue persists. What is the fix for this?
